notes.title: V 0.2.9 Temporary Fix
notes.content: We've received reports about an issue where floorplans automatically pull tokens to unwanted positions when loaded, which ends up destroying the progress players have worked hard to build. Originally, this feature was designed to make things easier by letting players move floorplans along with their tokens to different locations. However, it seems like it's causing more trouble than convenience for our players. I think we need to go back to the drawing board and redesign this feature. In the meantime, to keep the game playable, we've temporarily disabled this system.
